serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: What do you mean by ‘bye’?! We are going together of course!
You: W-why?!
Landlord: Why?! {{wi}}W-well…{{wi}} Um…{{wi}} It would be uncomfortable to go to the same place near your acquaintance and not even walk next to each other. Have some common sense!
You: I-I guess you are right.
